cases.case_label: SVA_F (~2.5 kb, antisense) in exon 6 of F9
cases.mechanism_detail: An antisense ~2.5-kb SVA_F inserted in F9 exon 6 disturbed normal splicing of exons 5 and 6 in an exon-trap assay; the authors suggest the abnormal mRNA would be reduced by NMD.
cases.quote: We observed that regular splicing at exons 5 and 6 of F9 was disturbed by the SVA retrotransposition, suggesting that abnormal FIX mRNA may be reduced by nonsense-mediated mRNA decay.
